name: MOW_SELECTED_ACT_TEMPLATES
description: Intersection table between MOW_ASSESSMENTS and ZMM_ACTIVITY_TEMPLATES.   Includes selected activity templates for a particular assessment.

columns.name: SELECTED_ACT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Primary key column to store unique strategy id.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Strategy name.  Auto generated from strategy template name.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Reference to activity template id.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status to indicate if  selected activities are in progress or completed.

columns.name: DESC_TEXT
columns.description: Strategy description text

columns.name: DATE_EMPLOYED
columns.description: Date strategy has been employed on.

columns.name: DATE_FINISHED
columns.description: Date on which all activities updated to 'COMPLETED'

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_ID
columns.description: Parent assessement ID. FK to 	MOW_ASSESSMENTS.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
